When STORAGE_MODE=file+projection, upserts all file-backed objects into the

graph projection and deletes projection orphans not present in file SSOT.

Also ensures spec-derived id indexes. Use --dry-run to count without writes.

  Rebuild projection from file durability store
  zqk system rebuild-graph-projection
  Preview counts only
  zqk system rebuild-graph-projection --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk system rebuild-graph-projection [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run            Count rebuilds and orphans without writing to the projection
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
